points.evidence: Actual MSVC original/current preprocessing compares1017 retained selected statements with zero logical-line mismatches. Existing excluded bodies and conditional boundaries unchanged.

getmsg16 can receive caller-supplied WM_COPYDATA through WU32CallMsgFilter or WU32DispatchMessage. Original scalar fallback passes segmented guest lParam and unconverted sender handle to native USER. Existing ThunkWMMsg16 COPYDATA case resolves handles and builds native COPYDATASTRUCT; caller finally wow_message_unwind16 releases captured owned buffers. No new converter is needed.

WI32DDEAddInitiator allocates and returns FALSE on failure; an outer same-HWND initiate may remain in DDEInitiateList. Original unconditional WI32DDEDeleteInitiator removes the first matching outer record even when inner allocation failed. Existing ThunkWMMsg16 captures acquisition success; UnThunkWMMsg16 tests it. Current selected unwind16 does not unthunk DDE again. Prior review claim that the unthunker clears this flag is stale and is not used as evidence.

Native message dispatch must not use a failed pointer-bearing conversion. ThunkMsg16 returns HWND-or-NULL, which cannot distinguish failure from a valid thread message with NULL HWND. Existing separate success result carries converter outcome; scalar/timer getmsg16 path needs TRUE. Original scalar operands and message conversion remain untouched; no second success state introduced.

putmsg16 invokes only WM32Command,WM32DropFiles and7 DDE converters via aw32Msg,always with fThunk=THUNKMSG. It initializes operands,hwnd,uMsg,uParam,lParam,pww,fFree andlpfnM32 before call. All selected reads are initialized; WM32DDEInitiate assigns dwTmp[3] before any unthunk read. lReturn reads belong to unthunk branches not called here. This frame has no generic finally/unwind consuming uninitialized fields. Whole-frame zero initialization is unnecessary; original declaration restored.
